primaryWitnesses.previousContext: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 211–212行が現代のLod市と古代からの都市史・聖書での言及を説明。
wikipediaRead.currentSupportParaphraseJa: Wikipedia Lod, lines 211–212 describes the present city and its long habitation, and lines 217–219 says the Hebrew name Lod appears in the Bible as a town founded with Ono by Shemed (1 Chronicles 8:12). The text preserves the name/history relation without equating the entire modern urban area with an archaeological site.
